_comment: USD per 1,000,000 tokens. anthropic.* rates are Anthropic's first-party API list prices (input/output confirmed live via the claude-api skill; cache_write/cache_read derived from Anthropic's documented cache-pricing ratios - 5-minute cache write = 1.25x input, cache read = 0.1x input - except claude-fable-5-1's cache_read, which the skill states directly). opencode_zen_free_approx.* are NOT sourced prices: opencode's Zen free-tier models are genuinely $0 to use, so these are rough approximate market-equivalent rates for comparably-sized open-weight models, for visibility only (see aggregate.py's approx="true" label). Recalibrate both tables as pricing changes or models are added/retired.
